notes.calculus-section-15-1-1: Each subrectangle has area4; sum xy over six sample points.
notes.calculus-section-15-1-2: Each subrectangle has area2. Use x=2,4 with y=−1,0,1 for a; x=0,2 with y=0,1,2 for b.
notes.calculus-section-15-1-6: Use depth samples at x=5,15 and y=5,15,25; each rectangle has area100ft². Other justified quadrature estimates need not equal this one.
notes.calculus-section-15-1-7: Read approximate contour values 27, 13, 5, 17 at (1,1), (3,1), (1,3), (3,3). Multiply their sum by 4; divide by area 16 for the average. These are interpolated visual estimates, not exact function values.
notes.calculus-section-15-1-8: Divide the state into16 equal rectangles and average the midpoint temperatures read from the contour map; contour interpolation permits nearby estimates.
